description.value: The Fox & Hounds is a long-established neighbourhood pub in Aldergrove, BC, whose fanciful origin story claims its heavy timber frame was shipped from England by a fox-hunting publican and reassembled in the alder grove that gave the town its name. Over generations the building grew through eclectic additions, each filled with artifacts and memorabilia, creating a distinctive collection of rooms. Touring cyclists will find a full-service kitchen with online ordering, a VIP rewards program, and a genuine community pub atmosphere on the edge of the Fraser Valley.
